title: AI-assisted user stories from fictional feedback
summary: Software-engineering students transform five fictional feedback statements about a social-media application into user stories. The AI-assisted variant requires ChatGPT 3.5 and permits students to revise its drafts; each story must include a Definition of Done and traceability to source feedback.

sources.title: Using Generative AI to Create User Stories in the Software Engineering Classroom
sources.evidence_quote: Group A was informed to work without ChatGPT, while Group B was required to use ChatGPT.

assessment.summary: Create user stories from five overlapping feedback statements, including a Definition of Done and source traceability.
student_actions: Prompt ChatGPT with the provided request.
Review and revise generated user stories.
Add a Definition of Done and identify source statements.

student_role.description: Students in this variant must use ChatGPT and may revise its response.

grading.method: Two professors applied a nine-property expanded INVEST rubric and reached consensus.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

evidence_excerpts.quote: Group A was informed to work without ChatGPT, while Group B was required to use ChatGPT.
